steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 350 °F.
Brush a medium baking pan with some of the oil.
Lay 2 filo pastry leaves in the pan, hanging 1 inch over the edges.
Sprinkle or brush the leaves with oil.
Lay 2 more leaves and oil them. Repeat until half of the leaves are in place.
Sprinkle 1 1/2 pounds of chopped spinach with 1 1/2 teaspoons of salt.
Mix the spinach well by hand.
Add 1 cup of diced feta cheese, 1/2 cup of chopped green onions and 2 to 3 eggs.
Add some of the oil and mix well.
Spread the spinach mixture over the filo leaves in the pan.
Cover the spinach with the rest of the leaves, 2 at a time, oiling between them.
Roll the hanging edges of the bottom leaves over the pie, like a pizza crust.
Sprinkle the top with oil.
Bake for 45 minutes, until golden brown. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Simple Healthy Recipes, Oklahoma Nutrition Information and Education - ONIE Project

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 400 °F.
Place 6 cupcake liners in a muffin pan.
In a mixing bowl, stir 1/2 cup of milk and 1/3 cup of applesauce until blended.
Stir in 1/2 cup of flour, 1/2 cup of oats and 1 cup of sugar.
Stir in 1/2 tablespoon of baking powder and 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon.
Mix until just moistened, without over mixing.
Gently stir in 1 chopped tart apple.
Spoon the batter into the cupcake liners.
Bake for 15 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
steps.spoken: Bake for 15 to twenty minutes, until a toothpick put in the middle comes out clean.

steps.instruction: Cool in the pan for 5 minutes before serving.
Store unused muffins in an airtight container.
Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Put 1 pound of chicken in a baking pan or casserole dish.
Sprinkle the chicken with 1 teaspoon each of garlic powder and black pepper.
Sprinkle on salt to taste, if you like.
Bake for 1 hour.
steps.spoken: Bake for 1 hour. Check with a thermometer that the thickest part reads 165 °F.

steps.instruction: Pierce each of the 4 potatoes several times with a fork.
Microwave one potato on high for 3 minutes, until tender.
steps.spoken: Microwave each potato on high for about 3 to four minutes, until tender. Do this for each of the 4 potatoes.

steps.instruction: Steam 4 cups of frozen mixed vegetables until hot.
Mix 1 cup of sour cream, 1/2 teaspoon each of dried oregano and basil, and pepper.
Split the potatoes down the center.
Fill the potatoes with the steamed vegetables.
Top the potatoes with the sour cream and serve hot.

ingredients.name: scallions, green onions, rinsed and finely chopped
salmon fillet, cut into 6 portions, 4 ounces each

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 400 °F.
Whisk 1 cup of sour cream, 2 teaspoons of dill and 3 tablespoons of scallions in a bowl.
Whisk in 2 tablespoons of Dijon mustard and 2 tablespoons of lemon juice.
Lightly coat a baking sheet with cooking spray.
Place 6 portions of salmon fillet, skin side down, on the baking sheet.
Sprinkle the salmon with 1/2 teaspoon each of garlic powder and pepper.
Spread the sauce over the salmon.
Bake for 20 minutes, until a thermometer reads 145 °F in the thickest part.
steps.spoken: Bake for about 20 minutes, until each piece is opaque in the center and flakes easily with a fork in the thickest part. A thermometer should read at least 145 °F.

steps.instruction: Serve right away.

ingredients.name: vanilla essence, or 1 small vanilla bean

steps.instruction: Soak 3/4 teaspoon of gelatin in 1 tablespoon of the cream for 5 minutes.
Pour the rest of the 2 cups of cream into a medium pan.
Add 1/2 cup of sugar, 1 1/2 teaspoons of vanilla essence and a pinch of salt.
Heat over medium heat, stirring now and then, until the sugar dissolves.
steps.spoken: Heat over medium heat, stirring now and then, until the sugar dissolves and tiny bubbles appear around the edge of the pan.

steps.instruction: Take the pan off the heat and stir in the gelatin until fully mixed.
Pour the mixture into small ramekins.
Let them set in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours.
steps.spoken: Let them set in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours, or up to overnight.

steps.instruction: Heat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add 1 duck, cut into pieces, skin side down.
steps.spoken: Add 1 duck, cut into pieces, skin side down. Add the duck pieces to the pot skin side down, so the fat melts out.

steps.instruction: Flip the duck and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add 4 minced garlic cloves, 4 minced shallots and 2 sliced red chilies.
Stir-fry for a few minutes, until fragrant.
Pour in 2 cans of coconut milk.
Add 2 bruised lemongrass stalks, 4 kaffir lime leaves and 4 bay leaves.
Add 2 teaspoons of salt, 1 teaspoon of sugar and 1 teaspoon of tamarind paste.
Stir everything well to combine.
Bring the pot to a boil.
Lower the heat and simmer for 1 hour, until the duck is tender.
steps.spoken: Lower the heat and simmer for about 1 hour, until the duck is tender and the sauce has thickened.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: The Best of La Cocina GOYA: Healthy, Tasty, Affordable Latin Cooking/ Lo Mejor de la Cocina GOYA: Cocina Latina Saludable, Rica y Económica, GOYA Foods

ingredients.name: low-sodium black beans, drained and rinsed (15.5 ounces)
reduced-fat Colby and Monterey Jack cheese, shredded

steps.instruction: Drain the liquid from 3/4 cup of salsa through a strainer and discard it.
Put the drained salsa in a medium bowl.
Mix in 1 can of black beans, 2 cups of cheese and 2 tablespoons of cilantro.
Divide the mixture over half of each tortilla, about 1/2 cup each.
Fold the tortillas in half.
Heat a large griddle or skillet over medium-high heat.
Brush the griddle with 1/2 teaspoon of olive oil.
Place the filled tortillas on the griddle.
Cook, flipping once, until golden brown and crisp and the cheese melts.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges.

ingredients.name: all purpose flour, plus extra for kneading

steps.instruction: Add 2 cups of all purpose flour and 1 cup of whole wheat flour to a gallon freezer bag.
Add 1 tablespoon of yeast, 3 tablespoons of sugar and 1 teaspoon of salt.
Add 3 tablespoons of powdered milk to the bag.
Squeeze the upper part of the bag to force out air, then seal it.
Shake and work the bag with your fingers to blend the ingredients.
Heat 1 cup of water to 120 °F.
steps.spoken: Heat 1 cup of water to 120 to 130 °F.

steps.instruction: Add the warm water and 3 tablespoons of vegetable oil to the bag, and reseal it.
Work the bag with your fingers until the dough is mixed and pulls away from the bag.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes, until smooth and stretchy.
steps.spoken: Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes, until it is smooth and stretchy. Add flour as needed.

steps.instruction: Put the dough back in the bag and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Shape the dough on a greased baking sheet or in a greased 4 by 8 inch loaf pan.
Cover with a clean cloth or plastic wrap and let it rise until doubled in size.
Heat the oven to 350 °F.
Bake until golden brown, 25 minutes or more.
steps.spoken: Bake until golden brown. This may take anywhere from 25 to 45 minutes.

steps.instruction: Remove the bread from the pan and cool it on a wire rack or clean dish towel.

ingredients.name: Granny Smith apples, peeled, cored and sliced

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 350 °F.
Put 4 sliced sweet potatoes in a greased 2-quart baking dish.
Add 4 sliced Granny Smith apples and 1/2 cup of raisins.
Mix 2 tablespoons of honey, 3 tablespoons of apple juice or cider and the butter.
steps.spoken: Mix 2 tablespoons of honey, 3 tablespoons of apple juice or cider and 3 tablespoons of melted butter.

steps.instruction: Pour the mixture over the dish.
Cover with foil and bake at 350 °F for 30 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cover with foil and bake at 350 °F for 30 to 45 minutes, until the sweet potatoes are tender and glazed.

ingredients.name: carrots, rinsed, peeled, shredded or thinly sliced and cut in half

steps.instruction: Put 1 cup of couscous and 1 teaspoon of olive oil in a 4-quart saucepan.
Add 2 tablespoons of walnuts, 1/4 teaspoon of salt and 1/8 teaspoon of pepper.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of pumpkin pie spice or cinnamon.
Cook and stir over medium heat just until the couscous begins to brown.
Slowly add 1 1/3 cups of water.
Add 2 tablespoons of raisins and 1/2 cup of carrots.
Cover the pan and bring to a boil over high heat.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it stand for 10 minutes.
Fluff the couscous with a fork.
Serve right away.

ingredients.name: whole fresh fish, such as tilapia or catfish, cleaned and scaled

steps.instruction: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Mix 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil and 1 teaspoon each of paprika and ginger in a bowl.
Mix in 1 teaspoon each of ground garlic, ground cumin and ground coriander.
Mix in salt and black pepper to taste, until you have a smooth marinade.
Pat the 2 fish dry with paper towels and put them on a plate or tray.
Brush both sides of the fish generously with the marinade.
Refrigerate the fish for 30 minutes if you like, or skip to grilling.
steps.spoken: If you like, refrigerate the fish for 30 minutes so the flavors soak in. This step is optional, so you can go straight to grilling if you are short on time.

steps.instruction: Oil the hot grill grates with a folded paper towel soaked in oil, held with tongs.
Carefully place the fish on the grill and close the lid.
Cook the fish for 4 minutes with the lid closed.
steps.spoken: Cook for about 4 to five minutes per side, depending on the thickness of the fish, until the flesh is opaque and flakes easily with a fork. You can brush the fish with the leftover marinade while it grills.

steps.instruction: Flip the fish and cook 4 more minutes.
steps.spoken: Flip the fish and cook 4 to five more minutes, until the flesh is opaque and flakes easily with a fork.

steps.instruction: Take the fish off the grill with tongs or a spatula, without breaking the flesh.
Serve the fish hot with lemon wedges to squeeze over it.
Mix 3/4 cup of coconut flour, 1 teaspoon of baking powder and a pinch of salt.
steps.spoken: In a big bowl, mix 3/4 cup of coconut flour, 1 teaspoon of baking powder and a pinch of salt.

steps.instruction: Stir in up to 1/2 teaspoon of xanthan gum, if you like.
steps.spoken: If you like, stir in 1/2 teaspoon or less of xanthan gum.

steps.instruction: Add 6 whole medium eggs and 1 tablespoon of coconut oil.
Mix well with a spoon until the batter gets thick.
steps.spoken: Mix well with a spoon until the batter gets thick. You can add extra coconut flour if it feels too liquid.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Pour the dough evenly into a loaf pan lined with parchment paper.
steps.spoken: Pour the dough evenly into a loaf pan. Line the pan with parchment paper, or coat it with butter.

steps.instruction: Bake for 35 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bake for 35 to forty-five minutes.

steps.instruction: Take the bread out of the oven and let it cool.
Heat the oven to 400 °F.
Lay 12 ounces of tortilla chips on a cookie sheet.
Toss 1 pound of cheese, 1/3 cup of chiles and 1/2 cup of onion together.
Sprinkle the cheese mixture over the tortilla chips.
Bake for 2 minutes, until the cheese melts.
steps.spoken: Bake for about 2 minutes, until the cheese has melted.

steps.instruction: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add 1 finely chopped onion to the oil.
Cook until the onion is soft and clear.
Stir in 3 cloves of minced garlic and 1 tablespoon of grated ginger.
Cook for 1 minute, until it smells fragrant.
Add 1 teaspoon of turmeric and 1 teaspoon of paprika.
Add 1/2 teaspoon each of cumin and coriander, and 1/4 teaspoon of cayenne pepper.
Mix well to coat the onions with the spices.
Add 2 peeled, cubed potatoes and 2 sliced carrots.
Stir to coat the vegetables with the spices.
Pour in 1/4 cup of water and cover the pot.
Cook for 5 minutes, to soften the potatoes and carrots.
Add 1 finely shredded cabbage to the pot.
Mix everything together and cover the pot.
Cook for 15 minutes, stirring now and then.
steps.spoken: Cook for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the cabbage is tender.

steps.instruction: Taste and season with salt.
Take the pot off the heat and let the stew rest a few minutes.
Top with chopped cilantro.

fennel-white-bean-and-kale-soup.title: Fennel White Bean and Kale Soup

ingredients.name: kale, or escarole, swiss chard or spinach

steps.instruction: Heat 1/2 cup of olive oil in a large soup pot over medium heat.
Add 2 small diced fennel bulbs and 2 small diced yellow onions.
Stir in 4 teaspoons of minced rosemary for 4 minutes, until tender.
steps.spoken: Stir in 4 teaspoons of minced fresh rosemary or thyme. Keep stirring for 4 to six minutes, until the fennel and onions are tender.

steps.instruction: Add 10 cloves of minced garlic and 1/2 to 1 teaspoon of red pepper flakes.
steps.spoken: Add 10 cloves of minced garlic and 1/2 to 1 teaspoon of red pepper flakes. Cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.

steps.instruction: Add 10 to 12 ounces of kale, a handful at a time.
steps.spoken: Add 10 to 12 ounces of kale, a handful at a time. Add the kale one handful at a time, stirring until the leaves wilt. Escarole, swiss chard or spinach can be used instead.

steps.instruction: Add 4 cans of rinsed cannellini beans, 4 cups of broth and black pepper.
Bring the soup to a boil, then turn it down to a simmer.
Simmer for 6 minutes, mashing some beans with a wooden spoon.
steps.spoken: Simmer for 6 to eight minutes, mashing some of the beans with a wooden spoon, until the liquid has reduced.

steps.instruction: Take the pot off the heat and stir in 2 tablespoons of lemon juice.
Stir in 6 tablespoons of grated parmesan.
Bring 4 quarts of water and 1 tablespoon of salt to a boil.
Add 1 pound of pasta to the boiling water.
Melt 3 tablespoons of butter in a pan over medium heat.
Add 4 cloves of minced garlic to the butter.
Drain the pasta and toss it in the garlic butter.

ingredients.name: colored sugar or nuts, for topping

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 350 °F.
Mix 1 stick of melted butter and 1 cup of sugar until completely combined.
Separate 2 eggs.
steps.spoken: Separate 2 eggs. Keep the whites for later.

steps.instruction: Mix in the egg yolks.
Mix in 2 cups of flour and 1 teaspoon of cinnamon.
steps.spoken: Mix in 2 cups of flour and 1 to 2 teaspoons of cinnamon, to taste. It is best to mix by hand, but a mixer works too.

steps.instruction: Pour the batter into a cookie pan.
Spread and smooth the batter over the whole pan with your palm.
steps.spoken: Use the palm of your hand to spread and smooth the batter over the whole pan. This is the hardest part.

steps.instruction: Brush the leftover egg whites over the batter.
Scatter colored sugar or nuts evenly over the batter.
Bake for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
steps.spoken: Bake for about 20 minutes, until the cookies are golden brown.

steps.instruction: Take the pan out and let the cookies cool slightly.
Cut them into small 1-inch squares before they get too cool.
Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Butter a 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Mix 2 cups of shredded potatoes, 1/2 cup of melted butter and 2 eggs in a bowl.
Mix in 1 teaspoon of minced onion, 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of paprika.
Place the potato mixture in the prepared baking dish.
Pour 1/2 cup of milk over the top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes.
Sprinkle 1/2 cup of shredded cheddar cheese over the top.
Return the dish to the oven until the cheese melts and is slightly browned.
Lightly spread 2 tablespoons of butter on one side of each of the 8 bread slices.
Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium heat until hot.
Place 2 bread slices, butter side down, in the skillet.
Top each bread slice with 2 slices of Swiss cheese and 1 tablespoon of dressing.
Top each with 3 ounces of corned beef and a quarter of the sauerkraut.
Top each with another bread slice, butter side up.
Cook 4 minutes, turning once, until golden brown and the cheese is melted.
steps.spoken: Cook the sandwiches for 4 to six minutes, turning once, until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted.

steps.instruction: Repeat with the remaining bread to make the other sandwiches.

source.name: NHLBI (NIH)
source.credit: NHLBI, NIH; Stay Young At Heart

steps.instruction: Pick through 1 pound of beans, remove any bad ones and rinse thoroughly.
Put the beans and 8 cups of water in a large pot.
Add 1 1/2 cups of chopped onion, 1 cup of chopped celery and 4 bay leaves.
Bring the pot to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover and cook for 90 minutes.
steps.spoken: Reduce the heat to low, cover and cook for 90 minutes. Reduce the heat to low, cover and cook for about an hour and a half, or until the beans are tender.

steps.instruction: Stir the beans and mash some against the side of the pot with a spoon.
Add 1 cup of green pepper, 3 tablespoons of garlic and 3 tablespoons of parsley.
Add 2 teaspoons of thyme, 1 teaspoon of salt and 1 teaspoon of black pepper.
Cook uncovered over low heat for 30 minutes, until creamy.
Remove the bay leaves.
Serve with hot cooked brown rice, if you like.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add 1 diced onion and 2 cloves of minced garlic.
steps.spoken: Add 1 diced onion and 2 cloves of minced garlic. Cook for about 5 minutes, until soft.

steps.instruction: Stir in 1 tablespoon of curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
steps.spoken: Stir in 1 tablespoon of curry powder and cook for about 1 minute, until it smells fragrant.

steps.instruction: Add 1 cup of red lentils, 1 can of diced tomatoes and 1 can of pineapple chunks.
Add 1 can of coconut milk and 2 cups of vegetable broth, then stir well.
Bring to a boil.
Lower the heat, cover and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring now and then.
steps.spoken: Lower the heat, cover and simmer for 25 to thirty minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils are soft.

steps.instruction: Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Heat the oven to 350 °F.
Combine 1 cup of fish stock and 1 cup of water in a baking dish.
Add 1 pound of salmon fillet to the dish.
steps.spoken: Add 1 pound of salmon fillet. The liquid should cover the salmon. If you need more liquid, add equal parts water and fish stock until it is covered.

steps.instruction: Add 1 sprig of fresh thyme and 1 sprig of fresh parsley.
Add 1/2 cup of huckleberries, 1 sliced lemon and 1 tablespoon of black peppercorns.
Bake the dish in the oven for 15 minutes, until the salmon is flaky.
steps.spoken: Put the dish in the heated oven and bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until the salmon is flaky.

source.name: NHLBI (NIH)
source.credit: NHLBI, NIH; Stay Young At Heart

steps.instruction: Put 1 large diced mango, 2 cups of blueberries and 2 sliced bananas in a large bowl.
Add 2 cups of halved strawberries and 2 cups of seedless grapes.
Add 2 sliced nectarines and 1 sliced kiwi fruit.
Mix the fruit together in the bowl.
Mix 1/3 cup of orange juice and 2 tablespoons of lemon juice in a small bowl.
Stir in 1 1/2 tablespoons of honey, 1/4 teaspoon of ground ginger and 1 dash of nutmeg.
Just before serving, pour the sauce over the fruit.
Mix 1/4 cup of sauerkraut, 2 tablespoons of chopped onion and chopped parsley.
Spread 2 tablespoons of Russian dressing on 2 slices of rye bread.
Pile 1/2 pound of corned beef, Swiss cheese and the sauerkraut mix on 1 slice.
steps.spoken: Pile layers of 1/2 pound of corned beef, 1 to 3 slices of Swiss cheese and the sauerkraut mixture on one slice of bread.

steps.instruction: Put the second slice of bread on top.
Butter the outside of the bread with 1 tablespoon of butter.
Grill the sandwich for 5 minutes, until lightly browned.
steps.spoken: Grill the sandwich for roughly 5 to 10 minutes, until lightly browned.

ingredients.name: small beets, leaves trimmed, each peeled and cut into four chunks

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 450 °F.
Cover a baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Toss 1 1/2 pounds of beets with 1 teaspoon of olive oil in a medium bowl.
steps.spoken: Toss 1 1/2 pounds of beets with 1 teaspoon of olive oil in a medium bowl. Toss the beets with the olive oil in a medium bowl until well coated.

steps.instruction: Spread the beets on the baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake for 30 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bake for 30 to forty minutes, until the beets are easily pierced with a sharp knife.

steps.instruction: Grate the zest of the orange into a small bowl.
Cut the orange in half and squeeze the juice into the bowl.
steps.spoken: Cut the orange in half and squeeze the juice, about 1/2 cup, into the bowl with the zest. Use a large spoon to press the inside of the orange to get more juice.

steps.instruction: Stir in 1/2 teaspoon of anise seeds if you like.
steps.spoken: Stir in 1/2 teaspoon of anise seeds if you like. Then set the bowl aside.

steps.instruction: Return the tender beets to the tossing bowl.
Pour the orange juice mixture over the beets.
Mix well to coat the beets, then serve.
Slice the 2 apples into wedges and place them in a bowl.
Pour 1 tablespoon of lemon juice over the apples.
steps.spoken: Pour 1 tablespoon of lemon juice over the apples, so they have a light coating. This keeps them from browning.

steps.instruction: Soak 1/3 cup of raisins in warm water for 5 minutes.
Drain the raisins well.
Mix the celery, raisins and walnuts into the apples.
Mix 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise and 1 tablespoon of sugar together.
Pour the mayonnaise mixture over the apples and mix to coat lightly.
Chill the salad for at least 30 minutes.
Place 3 lettuce leaves on each of 2 plates.
Put half of the salad on each set of leaves.
Sprinkle 5 halved cherries on each salad.

ingredients.name: zaatar leaves, without the stalks, cleaned and dried

steps.instruction: Lightly roast 1 cup of sesame seeds in a wide pan until golden brown.
steps.spoken: Lightly roast 1 cup of sesame seeds in a wide pan until they turn golden brown. You can skip this step if you like.

steps.instruction: Let the sesame seeds cool down completely.
Mix 1 cup of zaatar leaves with the sesame seeds.
Add 1 cup of sumac and 1 teaspoon of salt.
Adjust the sumac and salt to taste.
steps.spoken: Adjust the sumac and salt to taste. You can add citric acid salt for an extra kick if the sumac was not enough.

steps.instruction: Store in an airtight jar or container.
